messages:
Jordan: PR ready for final review — runtime optimizations + small config change. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/678
Priya: Looking now. quick q: any DB migration or rollout risk?
Jordan: No DB migration. Two main changes: 1) switch to adaptive batching config (default remains same) 2) allow KV-cache TTL override per-deployment. Risk: if TTL set too low could increase upstream load.
Sam: Can you paste perf delta? Jenkins or local numbers?
Jordan: Local perf (on ci-ci-large-gpu): median latency down ~8%, p99 roughly unchanged. Throughput +12% for 2048 seq. Artifact: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/pr-678/perf.csv
Alex: Platform: do we need an infra migration for the TTL config? Will it change config schema? @platform-team
Jordan: Schema bump: config.v2 -> adds optional field 'kv_cache_ttl_ms' default null. No migration necessary, handlers ignore null. snippet:
```
service_config:
  model:
    kv_cache_ttl_ms: null
```
Priya: Security: does this touch key management or secrets? @sec
Jordan: No new secrets. Uses existing KMS flow. Added one unit test to ensure KMS path unchanged. (see tests/kms_test.py)
ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Sam: I skimmed the code, left one minor comment on null handling. Otherwise +1 from runtime. :thumbsup:
Alex: Platform ok with schema change, please add a migration note to the release notes. small nits in docs.
Priya: Security: left one comment to assert expire behavior, but doesn't block. approve pending that test.
Jordan: Will add the test and docs update in a follow-up commit in this PR. Planning to merge today EOD PST if no other blockers.
Sam: pinging @eng-runtime for final manual approval (we need explicit approve to satisfy branch protection)
Alex: Approved from platform side.
Priya: Approved from security once test added.
Jordan: Thanks all — I'll push the follow-up shortly and tag for merge. :rocket:
